label: Pull requests into main, pushes to main, release tags
What the GITHUB_TOKEN of this job may do
Sign in to ghcr.io, except on pull requests
Tags naming the commit, branch, pull request and release
code:
- id: meta
  uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
  with:
    images: ghcr.io/rice-rocket/api
    tags: |
      type=sha
      type=ref,event=branch
      type=ref,event=pr
      type=semver,pattern={{version}}
      type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}

label: Build api/, push except on pull requests, reuse the cache
Build api/, push except on pull requests, reuse the cache
code:
- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    context: api
    push: true
    tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
    labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
    cache-from: type=gha
    cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

label: Sign in to ghcr.io, except on pull requests
Tags naming the commit, branch, pull request and release
code:
- id: meta
  uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
  with:
    images: ghcr.io/rice-rocket/api
    tags: |
      type=raw,value=latest
